notes.title: Dusk and Dawn release this weekend!
notes.notes:
The continuation of the story begun in Crimson Gray will be releasing very soon! Follow the page here if you want to know as soon as it's available:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/894460/Crimson_Gray_Dusk_and_Dawn/

I've added achievements and completed the last tasks required for a Steam release, so I hope that there will be no obstacles. Steam's changing policies required me to rework some things, but the plan right now is to not require any patch to play the full game.

If you are interested in Lizzie and John, please check it out when it releases! I tried to show some glimpses of their future while still giving the two of them a satisfying conclusion. If you'd like to see more, please cross your fingers along with me for the launch!
